quote: 如果我们过去本身有一些做得不够好的地方被错误地当成了今日测试标准，而实际上我们改进后的新版本比之前的版本更好、更接近原版 PDF，这种情况下我们要大胆去做，而不是以旧的、还不够好的版本为标准。; 3 接受
english: The maintainer's standing rule (2026-10-23, relayed by the coordinator): where something we did less well before was wrongly taken as today's test standard, and the new version is in fact better and closer to the original PDF, be bold and do it, rather than take the old, not good enough version as the standard; and decision 3 ("3 接受", 2026-10-22): what fails the check is shown untranslated. The coordinator told the maintainer of this ruling and its evidence (numbers and side-by-side crops of the pages that move); no further word was needed before merge. Coverage first: every unit of the body translated but formulas and code
on: the per-unit optional-content erasure's reader side (pull request of feat/ocg-reader, REMOVAL 8): a drawn unit's ink is hidden by its groups on our page wrapped by optional content (layer-proto/hide.mjs, visibility.mjs); a unit whose ink the wrap could not hide (no group of its own in the document, or listed unhidden: marks, across, spell, page, bounds; among them a unit that opens with a macro the marker gives no mark, whose ink precedes its start mark) is shown as the original and not drawn; no rectangle is erased, no paper fill, no add-on
scope: every target: text units left English +4 an output (de, es, fr, ko, ru 1 -> 5; ja 3 -> 7; zh 36 -> 40) on two pages, 1706.03762v7 p1 (3 units with no group: the title block the marker does not mark, docs/PDF-READER.md §19.9) and 2608.04322v1 p1 (its journal header, a spell refusal); cells left English on two tables, 1512.03385v1 p7 and 1810.04805v2 p7, the cells that open with a macro the marker gives no mark (1810.04805v2's \bertbase and \bertlarge among them; 14 cells of the pack, own.leaks): de 63 -> 67, es 63 -> 83, fr 13 -> 16, ja 67 -> 87, ko 46 -> 66, ru 81 -> 100, zh 11 -> 31; with them es full size 0.256 -> 0.253 and ko paragraph gaps tighter than the lines beside them 0.184 -> 0.185 (2608.04322v1 p1). No other model-tier measure moves; contentLost improves (ja 0.014 -> 0, zh 0.004 -> 0: 1810.04805v2 p3's placeholders shown once), and so does 1810.04805v2 p2's size spread
why: The standard is closeness to the original page. A unit whose ink cannot be hidden glyph for glyph was drawn before over rectangles that erased what lay under them, its own ink and anything else there, and a macro's ink the marks own no unit for stayed under the translation; it is now shown as the original, untranslated (decision 3, "3 接受"), until the marker marks the title block and those macros (the engine lane's item). On the pixel tier, run on 8 outputs of the same pack, both engines: overlap regions 22 -> 7, stray text 6 -> 5, residue at the erased rectangles 807 -> 276, erase bites 3,972 -> 3,876, graphics erased 822 -> 5, glyphs lost 60 -> 43, ink lost 40 -> 33, math vanished 167 -> 161, crops shown twice 3 -> 0, content lost 1 -> 0.
